title: aglaia iloilo
intro: Aglaia iloilo, commonly known as the Iloilo Aglaia, is a plant species in the Meliaceae family native to the Philippines. It is a type of evergreen tree with a range of medicinal properties. The health benefits of Aglaia iloilo include its potential in reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aglaia iloilo are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antiproliferative, and antimicrobial effects.
